items.exampleEn: We saw lions at the zoo.
items.exampleZh: 我們在動物園看到獅子。

items.exampleEn: This is a nice place to live.
items.exampleZh: 這是個很適合居住的好地方。

items.exampleEn: My office is near the station.
items.exampleZh: 我的辦公室在車站附近。

items.exampleEn: We learn about the war in history class.
items.exampleZh: 我們在歷史課學到那場戰爭。

items.exampleEn: The cows are in the field.
I grew up in a small town.
That tall building is a hotel.

items.sentenceEn: My office is in that building.
items.sentenceZh: 我的辦公室在那棟大樓裡。

items.audioEn: I live in a small town, but I work in the city.
items.audioZh: 我住在一個小鎮，但在城市裡工作。

items.sentenceEn: There are many tall buildings in this city.

items.stemEn: Let's take the kids to the ____ to see the animals.
items.stemZh: 我們帶孩子去動物園看動物吧。

items.passageEn: I live in a small town near a big city. Every day, I take the train to my office in the city. My office is in a tall building. On the weekend, I take my kids to the zoo or play ball with them in the field behind our house.
items.passageZh: 我住在大城市附近的一個小鎮。每天我搭火車到城裡的辦公室上班，我的辦公室在一棟高樓裡。週末時，我會帶孩子去動物園，或在我們家後面的田野陪他們玩球。

questions.questionZh: 說話者的辦公室在哪裡？
週末說話者會帶孩子去哪裡？

items.promptZh: 台北是一個很好的地方。
referenceEn: Taipei is a very nice place.
rubricZh: place 前面加 a 和形容詞（例如 a nice place、a great place）
主詞可寫 Taipei 或 It

referenceEn: This town is very quiet at night.
This town is quiet at night.
rubricZh: 「這個小鎮」可寫，例如 this town、this small town 等
「晚上」可寫，例如 at night、in the evening 等
